chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi', said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام about a woman who sees in her sleep and then emits discharge: is ghusl obligatory upon her? He said: Yes.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the legal ruling
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative answer establishing the ruling

ai.seo_question: Does ghusl become obligatory for a woman if she ejaculates in her sleep?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that if a woman experiences discharge in sleep, ghusl becomes obligatory upon her. It establishes that the ruling of janabah applies in such a case, including during sleep.
